facts.text: Nonapeptide + AHA 6% Underarm Roll-On
Controls Odour and Fades Underarm Darkness

A powerful AHA-infused roll-on that combats odour and fades underarm darkness. This aluminium-free formula inhibits bacterial growth, which keeps your underarms odour-free instead of masking it with fragrance. Nonapeptide-1 inhibits hyperproduction of melanin induced by α-MSH, hence fading underarm darkness & making it even looking.
"I have been using it for a month now and it's a good product with odour less effect and it reduces the darkness and pigmentation as well. -Arushi"
A gentle exfoliating underarm roll-on containing Mandelic Acid & Glycolic Acid which helps in neutralising bad odour causing bacteria and reveals an even underarm skin tone
It also contains a Biomimetic Peptide, Nonapeptide-1, which inhibits melanin synthesis by preventing activation of the tyrosinase. Thus helps in reducing underarm darkness

Boosted with 4-n-Butylresorcinol, Salicylic Acid and Licorice Root Extract, which further helps in reducing darkness of the underarms, sebum control and soothing. It also contains Decylene Glycol which kills bad odour causing bacterias
All our ingredients are sourced from leading global suppliers. Our high purity grade Mandelic Acid is sourced from Alfa Aesar, a trusted supplier from USA
Concerns: Dark Underarms, Sweating, Underarm Odour
Suitable for: 18+ years of age
An in-vitro study is conducted to evaluate the efficacy of the product against Corynebacterium Xerosis (a bad odor-causing bacteria). Below is the graphical representation of the data
The figure represents the 99.67% reduction of Corynebacterium xerosis in 10 minutes.
Objective : Determination of anti-bacterial efficacy of Minimalist Nonapeptide + AHA 06% underarm roll on against C. Xerosis by time kill assay as per ASTM E2315-16
Study Report Number: RR231167/MCR/TKA/07-2023
(Data based on in-vitro tests conducted by an independent third party product testing lab)
Note: The product has been evaluated for safety through patch testing under the supervision of a Dermatologist.
Apply on clean and dry armpits using the roller. Allow to dry before getting dressed.
For external use only. Patch test recommended before use.
When to use: AM. Everyday.
A powerful biomimetic peptide that helps reduce hyperpigmentation, promoting an even looking underarm complexion

Gentle exfoliating AHA that effectively removes dead skin cells and promotes natural cell turnover. It helps achieve an even underarm tone and reduces darkness, revealing smoother and revitalised skin
It can strongly inhibit the activity of tyrosinase, resulting in reduction of hyperpigmentation
It demonstrates potent anti-bacterial activity against Corynebacterium Xerosis by inhibiting growth and helps control malodor-causing components' production.

Water/Aqua, 1,2-Hexanediol, Triethyl Citrate, Mandelic Acid, Dimethyl Isosorbide, Propanediol, Ethoxydiglycol, Glycolic Acid, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein, Salicylic Acid, 2-Methyl 5-Cyclohexylpentanol, Decylene Glycol, Sodium PCA, 4-Butylresorcinol, Nonapeptide-1, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Liquorice) Root Extract, Pentylene Glycol, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Propylene Glycol, Sodium Hydroxide, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate

facts.section: Which skin type is this suitable for?
facts.text: The body roll-on is suitable for all skin types. The product is formulated keeping in mind all skin types.

facts.section: Can this product be used for men and women?
facts.text: Yes. This underarm roll-on works equally well for both men and women.

facts.section: What is the recommended age and who can use this product?
facts.text: Except for pregnant or breastfeeding women and those under 18 years of age, anyone can use this Roll-On.
